story.originalTitle: Austin, brought together. Grateful to be part of the community that makes this city what it is. From the streets to the circuit, it’s about you, us, ...
story.summaryEn:
Austin, brought together.
Grateful to be part of the community that makes this city what it is. From the streets to the circuit, it’s about you, us, together.
Thank you, Austin. 💚
detailZh:
奥斯汀，汇聚一堂。
感谢成为这个社区的一部分，它让这个城市成为它现在这样。
从街头到赛道，这一切都是关于你们，关于我们，一起。
感谢，奥斯汀。 💚
detailEn:
Austin, brought together.
Grateful to be part of the community that makes this city what it is. From the streets to the circuit, it’s about you, us, together.
Thank you, Austin. 💚
